episodes.synopsis: Having won first place at the Kyoto competition, Kumiko and the band are preparing to compete in the Kansai competition. A shadow looms over them when an old member, Nozomi Kasaki, enters the picture.
episodes.title: Mid-summer Fanfare

episodes.synopsis: Kumiko and her buddies head to the pool for one last breath of freedom before their grueling concert band training. There, Nozomi reveals some of what had happened the year before.
episodes.title: Hesitation Flute

episodes.synopsis: The high school Kitauji fanfare begins its intensive summer camp before the Kansai competition. Kumiko is still trying to find out more about Asuka's refusal to reinstate Nozomi and intends to respect her promise to the girl.
episodes.title: Troubled Nocturnes

episodes.synopsis: Nozomi finally meets Mizore. She learns, the hard way, why Asuka had been keeping her away.
episodes.title: Awakening Oboe

episodes.synopsis: Only three schools will be selected at the Kansai Concert Band Competition to compete in the Nationals. Will Kitauji High School be one of them?
episodes.title: Miraculous Harmony

episodes.synopsis: It's the school festival at Kitauji High School. Kumiko's sister insists on quitting college, while Taki reveals some things about his past with his wife.
episodes.title: Rainy Conductor

episodes.synopsis: Asuka's mother wants her to quit the concert band. This upsets everyone -- including her mother.
episodes.title: Station Concert

episodes.synopsis: Asuka invites Kumiko over for a study party. With Kumiko's sister quitting college and Asuka's band membership uncertain, Kumiko and Reina are forced to contemplate the role of music in their lives.
episodes.title: Rhapsody in Flu

episodes.synopsis: Asuka is about to lose her seat competing in the Nationals. But that might not be why she invited Kumiko over.
episodes.title: Sound! Euphonium

episodes.synopsis: Taki's deadline for Asuka draws near. She refuses to admit that she wants, more than anyone, to compete in the Nationals.
episodes.title: After-school Obbligato

episodes.synopsis: With Asuka back in the competition, the orchestra is just about set for the Nationals. Meanwhile, Kumiko tries to understand why Reina is upset at her.
episodes.title: First Love Trumpet

episodes.synopsis: It's the big day: the All Japan Concert Band Competition Nationals.
episodes.title: The Last Competition

episodes.synopsis: With the competition over and the third-years graduating, Kumiko is left to sort through her feelings: Is it a love of concert band, of the euphonium, or of something else?
episodes.title: Early-Spring Epilogue
